text:
Asking rents in Lubeck stand at a median of 12.30 €/m² (2026-06), up 5.1% on the year and +32.1% over five years. That ranks Lubeck #16 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 65% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.47 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 738 € a month in cold rent, 17.3% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 24 days and 26% are gone within a week; with 1.5% market-active vacancy and +0.8% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 12.89 €/m² (+4.8%), with an 80% range of 12.60 to 13.20 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
